test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In each of the number-pairs, the second number is obtained by performing a certain mathematical operation on the first number. Three of the following pairs follow the same pattern and thus form a group. Select the number-pair that does NOT belong to that group.
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From option 1:-

 
• (22, 34)
 
• 22 × 2 = 44 - 10 = 34

From option 2:-

 
• (11, 12)
 
• 11 × 2 = 22 - 10 = 12

**From option 3:-**

 
• (25, 42)
 
• 25 × 2 = 50 - 10 = **40 ≠ 42**,
 
• It is different from others.

From option 4:-

 
• (17, 24)
 
• 17 × 2 = 34 - 10 = 24

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
